rules.title: Lock released with no motion nearby
rules.description: Someone normally walks past the motion sensor when the lock is released. No motion within 30 s either side is worth a look.

rules.title: Door opened soon after lock release
rules.description: Context rule: places a door opening next to the lock release that allowed it.

rules.title: Repeated door openings
rules.description: More than one door opening every 4 s on average for a minute is unusual for a household door.

rules.title: Lock event seen by only one source
rules.description: The device and the gateway should both record lock events; one-sided records need corroboration.

rules.title: Lock released at night
rules.description: Lock releases between 23:00 and 06:00 local time are unusual for this household. Set timezone to the household's zone (an IANA name such as Europe/London follows daylight saving).

rules.title: Unexpected MQTT client identity
rules.description: Each device should publish under its own client ID, and only the gateway logger may hold other sessions. Another client ID may be a spoofed or misconfigured client.
